how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-teldrassil-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:937:obj:0: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
rows.quest:937:details:0: I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.
rows.quest:937:details:1: When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to ⟦E1⟧ with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.
rows.quest:937:details:2: If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
rows.quest:937:progress:0: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, ⟦1⟧, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
rows.quest:937:completion:0: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, ⟦2⟧. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.
rows.quest:937:completion:1: I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
rows.quest:940:obj:0: Deliver the Oracle Tree's report to Arch ⟦E2⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:940:details:0: The forest whispers of your feats of valor, ⟦3⟧. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch ⟦E2⟧, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.
rows.quest:940:details:1: Deliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.
rows.quest:940:progress:0: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, ⟦4⟧. What business do you have with the Arch ⟦E2⟧ of the Kaldorei?
rows.quest:940:completion:0: I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.
rows.quest:940:completion:1: I ⟦E3⟧ my work on ⟦E4⟧ shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.
rows.quest:940:completion:2: Nonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
rows.quest:7383:obj:0: Fill the ⟦E5⟧ and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:7383:details:0: All was not well with ⟦E4⟧, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on ⟦E4⟧ may be attributed.
rows.quest:7383:details:1: However, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
rows.quest:7383:progress:0: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch ⟦E2⟧ have been carefully monitoring the growth of ⟦E4⟧. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
rows.quest:7383:completion:0: To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take ⟦E6⟧. Let me continue the telling...
rows.quest:7383:completion:1: With ⟦E4⟧ grown, the Arch ⟦E2⟧ approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his ⟦E7⟧, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her ⟦E7⟧, ⟦E4⟧'s growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
rows.quest:486:obj:0: Kill ⟦E8⟧ and return to Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:486:details:0: Now the time has come to save the Druids of the Talon. If we fail now, ⟦5⟧, they will be forever lost in sleep.
rows.quest:486:details:1: I shall prepare the Relics of Wakening and perform the ritual. For my work to take ⟦E9⟧, the cursed beast responsible for this horrible situation must be slain. Only then will the ritual be complete.

rows.quest:486:completion:0: ⟦7⟧ you have proven yourself a most worthy and able ⟦8⟧. A night elf who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.
rows.quest:486:completion:1: May the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
rows.quest:927:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E11⟧ to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
rows.quest:927:details:0: The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss. In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now.
rows.quest:927:details:1: Perhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.
rows.quest:927:completion:0: ...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!
rows.quest:927:completion:1: Thank you for bringing this to me, ⟦10⟧. I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.
rows.quest:938:obj:0: Escort ⟦E12⟧ to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
rows.quest:938:details:0: The sabercat's fur is a distinctive gray color, blending into the surrounding forest. As she lays there, you observe that she is badly wounded, with deep lacerations across her back and stomach.
rows.quest:938:details:1: She raises her head and gazes at you, bright intelligence shining in blue eyes. She seems to wish to follow you.
rows.quest:938:progress:0: ⟦E12⟧... It was my fault! The witches caught me off guard... I should not have let them take you...
rows.quest:938:completion:0: Oh, thank you, ⟦11⟧! I feared I would never see ⟦E12⟧ again, knowing only her death in my heart, never to be united with my faithful companion. I owe you more than you can know, and you have my eternal gratitude.
rows.quest:941:details:0: I have removed that foul moss from the heart, but it remains tainted...
rows.quest:941:details:1: Try placing the heart in my planter. It is filled with a nutritive soil that may cleanse and ⟦E14⟧ the heart.
rows.quest:941:progress:0: This planter is filled with soil, specially prepared by Denalan.
rows.quest:941:completion:0: You place the heart within the planter, and it quickly digs itself in!
rows.quest:941:completion:1: BA few seconds later it wriggles back out, cleansed. It pulses slightly... beckoning for you to take it.
